Monitorearás costos de forma continua. Actuarás como referente técnico, empoderando a los equipos de desarrollo en el uso óptimo de AWS.

Usarás IA de forma integrada a tu flujo real de trabajo: agentes, MCPs o skills , especialmente en tareas de análisis, automatización y desarrollo.
Investigarás y desplegarás automatizaciones basadas en agentes de IA para optimizar procesos internos y eliminar tareas manuales.

Sobre el Cargo
Como Ingeniero DevOps, coliderarás el diseño y la operación de la plataforma cloud de Tenpo bajo los estándares globales del equipo DevOps, actuando como puente robusto entre los equipos de desarrollo y la infraestructura que habilita los servicios digitales del neobanco.

Tu rol no es el de un ejecutor aislado de tickets: eres un diseñador de infraestructura y enlace estratégico que define e implementa estándares transversales de DevOps para toda la compañía.

Dado que la infraestructura crítica de data y la gerencia completa de Data residen en Google Cloud, tu expertise en GCP será determinante para garantizar la gobernanza, la estabilidad y la eficiencia del ecosistema de analítica e IA de Tenpo Bank.
Responsabilidades del cargo
1. Ownership de infraestructura cloud
Asumir el ownership de los proyectos de infraestructura asignados, diseñando, desplegando y manteniendo arquitecturas cloud resilientes, escalables y eficientes en costo en GCP, con criterio de Infrastructure as Code (laC) desde el inicio.
2. Gobernanza y hardening de la plataforma
Diseñar y ejecutar estándares de seguridad globales para la infraestructura de Tenpo en GCP, incluyendo gestión de identidades y accesos (IAM), hardening de workloads, configuración de políticas de seguridad y coordinacion con el equipo de Seguridad de la Informacion para el cumplimiento de CIS Benchmarks y normativa aplicable al neobanco.
3. Habilitación del ecosistema de Data e IA
Asegurar la automatización con Terraform y la estabilidad de las plataformas críticas de Data en GCP (BigQuery, Vertex Al, Cloud Composer/Airflow), actuando como contraparte tecnica de la gerencia de Data bajo las reglas de gobierno DevOps de Tenpo y optimizando su operación desde una perspectiva de infraestructura y FinOps.
4. Networking avanzado en GCP
Diseñar, implementar y mantener la arquitectura de networking de Tenpo en GCP: VPCs, subnets, firewall rules, Cloud NAT, VPN/Interconnect y políticas de seguridad de red, asegurando segmentación correcta y conectividad confiable entre servicios internos y externos.
5. Gestión y optimización de costos de infraestructura
Administrar la infraestructura de manera efectiva en costo y plazos, monitoreando el gasto cloud, identificando oportunidades de rightsizing, reservas y optimización de recursos, y reportando desviaciones con propuestas concretas.
6. CI/CD y automatización de despliegues
Diseñar, construir y mantener pipelines de integración y entrega continua (CI/CD) que permitan a los squads de producto desplegar con velocidad, seguridad y trazabilidad, reduciendo el riesgo de errores en producción y el tiempo de ciclo de entrega.
7. Infraestructura como código (laC)
Implementar y mantener la infraestructura de Ienpo como código utilizando Terraform avanzado, asegurando versionado, revisión por pares y documentación de todos los recursos cloud, eliminando la configuración manual como práctica.
8. Observabilidad y gestión de incidentes
Implementar y operar soluciones de observabilidad (logging, metricas, trazas distribuidas) con Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus o equivalente, definiendo alertas que anticipen degradaciones y liderando la respuesta ante incidentes con diagnóstico, contencion, resolución y post-mortem documentado.
9. Parches, actualizaciones y colaboracion transversal
Mantener actualizada la infraestructura con los parches y versiones correspondientes, gestionando CVEs críticos dentro de los SLAs definidos y trabajando junto a los squads de ingeniería en iniciativas transversales de plataforma que reduzcan la fricción operacional en el ciclo de entrega.
¿Qué necesitas para postular?
Formación académica
Ingeniería Civil en Informática, Ingeniería en Computación, Ingeniería en Redes o carreras afines. Se valora por sobre la formación de origen una trayectoria técnica comprobable con proyectos en producción en GCP.
Idiomas
Español: nativo.
Inglés: nivel intermedio a avanzado para lectura de documentación técnica de cloud providers, frameworks DevOps y comunidad de ingeniería internacional.
Dominio técnico

GCP avanzado: diseño y operación de arquitecturas de alta disponibilidad en Google Cloud (Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Networking, IAM, Cloud Storage, Cloud Armor).
Orquestación de contenedores: dominio sólido de GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine) y Cloud Run para despliegue y operación de microservicios a escala.
IaC y scripting: uso avanzado de Terraform para gestión declarativa de recursos cloud; Python o Go para automatización de infraestructura.
CI/CD: diseño y mantenimiento de pipelines con Cloud Build, GitHub Actions o GitLab CI integrados con GCP.
Observabilidad: implementación y operación de stacks de monitoring, logging y tracing (Cloud Operations Suite / Stackdriver, Datadog o equivalente).

Conocimiento del ecosistema GCP de Data e IA: BigQuery, Vertex AI y Cloud Composer (Airflow), con foco en infraestructura, gobernanza y costos (FinOps).
GitOps: experiencia con ArgoCD o Flux para gestión declarativa de despliegues en Kubernetes.
Service mesh: Istio o Linkerd para gestión de tráfico y seguridad entre microservicios.
Seguridad cloud: CIS Benchmarks, CSPM y gestión de secrets (Vault, Secret Manager).
Experiencia complementaria en otros cloud providers (AWS o Azure).
Experiencia crítica
Contexto del rol: En Tenpo , la infraestructura no es una commodity: es la columna vertebral sobre la que descansan la confianza del usuario y la continuidad del servicio financiero. Con una infraestructura crítica de data e IA operando en GCP, el/la Ingeniero/a DevOps es el guardián de la gobernanza de la plataforma y el habilitador técnico que permite escalar el negocio sin comprometer la seguridad ni la eficiencia operacional.

Diseño y operación de infraestructura cloud en GCP en entornos de producción con alta concurrencia y requisitos exigentes de disponibilidad.
Implementación de pipelines CI/CD completos con integración de pruebas automatizadas, seguridad y despliegue a GKE.
Gestión de incidentes de infraestructura en producción: diagnóstico, contención, resolución y post-mortem documentado.
Implementación de estándares de gobernanza, IAM y hardening en GCP para entornos regulados o de alta exigencia de seguridad.

Automation & CI/CD Pipelines: Build and maintain automated multi-environment deployment pipelines (Dev, Staging, Prod) for Apigee artifacts using tools like Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
API Testing & Debugging: Perform end-to-end API testing, trace request/response execution flows, troubleshoot latency bottlenecks, and debug production proxy issues.

Apigee X & GCP Networking: Proven hands-on experience with Apigee X architecture, API proxies, KVMs, and GCP networking infrastructure (VPCs, PSC, Load Balancing).
API Security & Identity: Deep understanding of API security protocols, including OAuth 2.0 flow mechanisms, JWT token validation, and API key management.
Secrets Management: Practical experience with credential mediation and secret management tools (GCP Secret Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or Apigee KVMs).
Target Endpoint & TLS: Hands-on expertise configuring backend target servers, mTLS, and SSL/TLS certificate management.
CI/CD Automation: Demonstrated ability to automate Apigee deployments across multiple environments using modern CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Cloud Build, Terraform).
Testing & Debugging: Proficient in API testing tools (Postman, Bruno, or curl) and native Apigee tracing/debugging tools.
Financial & Treasury Integrations: Prior exposure to enterprise financial systems or treasury platforms (e.g., Kyriba APIs) (nice to have)
Google Apps Script: Experience using Google Apps Script for automated operational integrations or custom workflows. ((nice to have)
Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience configuring GCP Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, and setting up proactive operational alerting dashboards for API health. (nice to have)

Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.
SICPA sets the pulse of sovereignty, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.
Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
The Platform Team is responsible for building, operating and continuously evolving cloud platform capabilities and core infrastructure services that enable the development, deployment, and operation of secure, scalable, and mission\-critical digital solutions. The team works at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, automation, and software engineering to provide a robust Platform\-as\-a\-Service foundation for SICPA's digital products and services.
We are looking for a Senior Cloud Platform Engineer who is passionate about cloud\-native technologies, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and enjoys designing, delivering, and operating modern cloud platforms that empower development teams and business solutions.

Architect, develop and operate cloud platform capabilities and core infrastructure services.
Contribute to the definition and execution of the platform's technical and functional roadmap.
Design and implement Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions to enable consistent, scalable, and automated deployments across cloud and on\-premises environments.
Build, maintain and optimize CI/CD platforms, pipelines and automation frameworks supporting software delivery at scale.
Design and implement cloud operational best practices, including monitoring, observability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
Develop and maintain platform services, automation tooling, and operational capabilities using modern software engineering practices.
Apply software engineering best practices, including automated testing, peer code reviews, documentation, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, and product teams to improve platform adoption and developer experience.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, platform planning, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support the deployment and operation of cloud\-native platforms, data services, and infrastructure components.
Your Profile
BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Proven experience as a Cloud Platform Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or equivalent role.
Strong experience deploying and operating Kubernetes\-based container platforms.
Experience with one or more major public cloud providers such as Azure, AWS, or equivalent cloud technologies.
Strong programming and automation skills in and shell scripting.
Ability to understand, troubleshoot and collaborate on solutions developed in languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, Groovy or similar.
Experience building and maintaining container images and Kubernetes ecosystem components, including Helm and Operators.
Experience designing and operating CI/CD platforms, workflows, and deployment automation.
Strong hands\-on experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code and configuration management technologies such as Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Ansible.
Experience operating cloud\-native data and messaging platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies.
Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, and distributed systems concepts.
Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with the ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration across teams.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and modern software delivery practices.
Fluent in English; French is a plus. jpid5a5c093jm jit0936jm jiy26jm

The Scope The Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer is responsible for implementing, operating, maintaining, and continuously improving FSC's cloud and on-premises infrastructure services. The role ensures the availability, reliability, security, and performance of infrastructure platforms that support FSC's business operations and digital services.
As part of the Operations & Cybersecurity function within the Technology & Information Unit (TIU), the role works closely with Platform & DevOps, Service Management, Technical Product Owners, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure services through proactive operations, automation, and continuous improvement.
Main Roles & Responsibilities Design, deploy, operate, and continuously improve cloud and on-premises infrastructure services that support FSC's global operations and digital platforms.
Administer and optimize infrastructure technologies, including cloud platforms, Windows Server, Active Directory, virtualization, networking, storage, and enterprise collaboration services.
Manage the infrastructure lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades, monitoring, capacity management, and decommissioning.
Support cloud adoption and modernization initiatives through the implementation of secure, scalable, and resilient hybrid infrastructure solutions.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, security, and operational stability of infrastructure services.
Deploy, configure, and operate infrastructure using approved automation, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) patterns, and platform standards established by the Platform & DevOps function.
Maintain backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities to support organizational resilience.
Collaborate with Cybersecurity team to implement security controls, remediate vulnerabilities, and maintain compliance with organizational policies and standards.
Support networking services, including LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, cloud networking, and secure connectivity across distributed environments.
Support the infrastructure requirements of enterprise cloud, data, analytics, AI, and business application platforms.
Leverage approved AI-assisted tools to improve troubleshooting, documentation, knowledge management, and operational efficiency.
Maintain infrastructure documentation, technical standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
Contribute to infrastructure projects, audits, service improvements, and other duties as assigned in alignment with organizational needs.
Ways of Working Operate within the TIU operating model, including ITIL-aligned service management, change and release processes, architecture governance, and demand management.
Collaborate across Platform & DevOps, Cybersecurity, Service Management, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure services.
Maintain essential operational documentation, including runbooks, support models, and key technical decisions.
Adopt automation-first and AI-assisted approaches to improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality.
Your profile Education and Training University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
Relevant professional certifications are desirable, such as Microsoft Azure Administrator/Architect, AWS Solutions Architect, VMware Certified Professional (VCP), Red Hat Certified Specialist, Terraform Associate, or equivalent cloud and infrastructure certifications.
Working Experience, Style, and Skills 3+ years of experience supporting cloud and on-premises infrastructure environments, including Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, Windows Server, VMware, Active Directory, networking, and enterprise infrastructure services.
Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments, infrastructure operations, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities.
Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven, with a focus on service reliability, operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted tools and modern technologies to improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Effective team player with the ability to work across Infrastructure, Platform & DevOps, Cybersecurity, and business teams.
Computer Skills Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, virtualization, identity and access management, networking, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, VMware, Hyper-V, and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
Understanding of networking technologies, including LAN/WAN, VPN, network segmentation, routing, and switching.
Familiarity with infrastructure automation, monitoring, and operational tooling.
Familiarity with cloud-native data and AI platforms, including Microsoft Fabric and Azure AI services, from an infrastructure and operational support perspective.
Skilled in implementing and supporting security, compliance, and governance requirements across hybrid environments.
Language and Communication Skills Fluency in English (spoken and written).
German is an advantage.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Why us? Be part of a globally respected organization shaping the future of sustainable forestry.
Work with a diverse international team representing 60+ nationalities.
Join a global FSC community of over 400 forest stewards.

Should you not receive a confirmation of receipt please check your spam filter and if you cannot find it there contact us at Please be informed, that by applying for this position you automatically accept our Data Protection Information on processing your personal data. We are looking forward to your application!

Hivemind is looking for an experienced SRE lead to help drive the establishment of our SRE function.

As the SRE lead, you will establish and mature the reliability practices used across our cloud infrastructure and platform services. You will work with Cloud Engineering and product teams to define reliability targets, improve observability, and ensure that production systems can be operated and recovered predictably.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. You will investigate complex failures, improve the systems and tooling used to operate our platforms, and turn lessons from incidents into engineering improvements. You will provide technical leadership for reliability engineering, helping teams adopt practices that improve system health without adding unnecessary process.

You will act as a thought-leader and mentor within the Cloud Engineering and Reliability teams to level up teammates and encourage building with a reliability-first mindset.

Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and other measures of service reliability
Build and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing for infrastructure and platform services
Lead technical response to complex incidents and drive root-cause analysis through resolution
Identify recurring failure modes and work with engineering teams to eliminate them
Improve system resilience through automation, testing, capacity planning, and failure recovery
Develop tooling and automation that reduces manual operational work
Partner with product and platform teams to incorporate reliability requirements into system design
Establish incident response practices that improve detection, diagnosis, communication, and recovery
Mentor product engineers and drive adoption of strong reliability and operational practices
Mentor teammates in SRE and Cloud Engineering
Define and manage short-and-long term SRE roadmap, distributing work across teammates

This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.
The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications.

You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle.

Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.

Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.
Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.
Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.
Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora, and other Business Systems.
Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.
Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.
Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.
Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.
Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.
Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.
Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.
Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.

7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.
Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.

Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure.
This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams.
We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working.
Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United Kingdom only. Candidates based in the United States or Canada can apply to this posting: Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — AMER (Intermediate to Senior Staff)
How our SRE hiring works
Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team.
Recruiter Screen: A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction.
Core Technical: The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review.
Hiring Manager Interview: A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab.
Peer Technical: Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on.
Skip-Level Interview: A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams.
After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.
We’ll calibrate your level throughout the interview process based on the scope and impact of your experience.
Intermediate: You independently deliver meaningful reliability improvements within a defined area.
Senior: You own complex reliability work end to end and raise the effectiveness of your team.
Staff: You shape reliability across multiple teams, solving systemic problems and creating approaches others can reuse.
Senior Staff: You set technical direction across a broader Infrastructure area and influence reliability strategy at organizational scale.

lead technical improvements across team boundaries;

s.h: WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT PLATFORM ENGINEERING
s.t:
We are looking for a talented and inquisitive Senior DevOps Engineer whose drive for learning and determination for continuous improvement aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing and transforming company.

Based in our London office, you will be a key player in planning, designing, building and testing the features of our next-generation cloud platform that combines digital video assets, wearable data and athlete information to provide insights and analytics to coaching/support staff, sports scientists and athletes to assist in optimizing athlete performance.

We believe that our customers deserve the best platform and we are on a mission to maximize and enhance their performance through delivering a high-quality experience.

Our software and DevOps engineers match this ethos by taking responsibility for constantly improving productivity and development of self and be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.

Cloud & Platform Engineering
Infrastructure Automation & IaC: Own infrastructure provisioning and configuration management (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
Observability & Reliability: Design, build and maintain logging, monitoring, alerting, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure system health and performance.
Software Delivery Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, safe, and repeatable software delivery.
Infrastructure Operations & Governance: Oversee the availability, scalability, and performance of cloud and on-prem infrastructure while ensuring all systems remain strictly aligned with corporate security standards and global regulatory compliance.
Cloud Security
Cloud Security & Compliance: Ensure compliance with relevant compliance and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR as applicable) and implement best practices cloud security controls.
Security Operation: Lead security first approach, collaborate with Security and IT teams to make sure our infrastructure is patched according to SLAs.
Application Security (AppSec): Collaborate with security teams to embed security controls into CI/CD pipelines and platform services.
Technology leader
Architectural Roadmap & Vision: Define and execute the long-term technical roadmap for Catapult's global cloud platform, evaluating emerging technologies (e.g., Serverless, AI-driven operations, and Containerization) to ensure the infrastructure remains cutting-edge, scalable, and best to used by our customers.
Technical Governance & Standards: Be a big contribution to infrastructure decisions, establishing "Golden Paths" and reusable Infrastructure as Code patterns that dictate how engineering teams deploy services while ensuring consistency across all environments.
Strategic Security & Compliance Integration: Architect and champion a "Shift-Left" security strategy, mandating the integration of automated security guardrails and compliance auditing into the core fabric of the CI/CD pipelines to protect athlete and video data globally.

Significant experience in DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform or Infrastructure Engineering, with tenure in technical leadership role.
Deep expertise in the AWS cloud platform and associated security and compliance practices.
Strong background in infrastructure automation (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.
Proven experience with big platform re-design, architecture of new cloud infrastructure systems based on software and business requirements.
Solid understanding of AppSec principles, including integrating security into build and deploy pipelines.
Experience managing hybrid environments, including traditional data centers and on-prem services.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence across engineering, security, and finance.
Experience with regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, fintech).
Familiarity with multiple compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).

s.h: WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE
s.t:
In 6 months time…
By the half-year mark, you will have moved beyond the onboarding phase to become the primary authority on Catapult's infrastructure.
Infrastructure Ownership: You will fully own the cloud infrastructure, having gained a deep understanding of all interconnected parts that support their athlete and video data services.
Established Automation: You will have taken control of infrastructure provisioning and configuration management, ensuring that Terraform or Ansible are being used effectively for IaC.
Observability Implementation: You will have designed and begun maintaining essential logging, monitoring, and SLO/SLI frameworks to ensure high system health and performance.
Have a full understanding of Catapult's products and the way we are working in order to be able to architect any new future existing or new product.
In 12 months time…
By the end of your first year, you will be driving the "next generation" of Catapult's technology stack and leading cross-functional improvements.
End to End Platform Ownership: You will take full accountability for the evolution of our production ecosystem, architecting a resilient, "deploy-anywhere" infrastructure that scales seamlessly with software demands and business growth.
Optimized Delivery: You will have refined the CI/CD pipelines to a state where software delivery is consistently fast, safe, and repeatable across the engineering team.
Integrated Security and Compliance: You will have transitioned the platform to a "security-first" architecture, successfully embedding automated AppSec controls and vulnerability scanning directly into the CI/CD pipelines.
Cross-Departmental Influence: Your success will be reflected in your ability to influence stakeholders across engineering, security, and finance to drive technical and operational improvements.

We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter.

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

Platform Observability & Analytics runs the infrastructure that tells Elastic the truth about its own platform. The observability clusters show Cloud engineers how production is behaving right now, and the analytics pipelines show the business how the platform and the products get used over time.
This role sits on the observability side. We run 200+ hosted deployments across every supported cloud region, ingesting logs, metrics and traces for all of Elastic Cloud, plus the SLA and SLO monitoring for ESS and Serverless. When Cloud engineering needs to know what production is doing, they're looking at something we run.
What You Will Be Doing
Owning end-to-end delivery of moderate-to-high complexity projects on the team’s roadmap , with minimal day-to-day direction.
Operating and hardening shared Elastic Cloud infrastructure (ECH, ECE, and ECK) as Infrastructure as Code – writing and reviewing the Terraform, Python, and Go that other engineers depend on.
Carrying a 24/7 on-call rotation: responding to incidents, driving them to resolution, and writing clear RCAs/postmortems that lead to lasting fixes rather than repeat pages.
Reviewing others’ code and designs, and being a trusted second set of eyes on production changes to critical infrastructure.
Mentoring less experienced engineers, and proactively raising risks, ideas, and improvements in team discussions.
Improving runbooks, documentation, and operational processes so the on-call load gets lighter over time.

5+ years of SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering experience
Proficiency with Terraform; comfortable owning large, multi-workspace configurations in a team setting
Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python; comfort with Go is a plus.
Deep Linux systems knowledge and experience operating containerized workloads in production.
Experience carrying a 24/7 on-call rotation, resolving incidents under pressure , and writing RCAs that hold up under review.
A track record of consistently delivering end-to-end projects of moderate-to-high complexity with minimal oversight, and being a valuable code/design reviewer for your team.
Comfort thinking about the security implications of the infrastructure you build, not just its reliability – you don’t need to be a security specialist, but you default to a security-conscious mindset.
A pattern of mentoring less experienced engineers and speaking up with ideas and concerns in team discussions.
Clear written and verbal communication – you document what you build and can explain it to both engineers and non-engineers.
Comfort working across time zones, in both real-time and asynchronous contexts.

Experience with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Beats, Kibana) in production.
Experience with GitOps-style deployment tooling (ArgoCD, Helm) or policy-as-code frameworks (e.g., Kyverno) on Kubernetes.
Experience with secrets management (Vault) or access-control/bastion tooling (Teleport).
Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Puppet, Ansible) at fleet scale.
Exposure to FedRAMP, GovCloud, or other regulated/compliance-driven infrastructure.

s.h: What you can look forward to
s.t:
trivago is a place where technical ambition meets genuine investment in your growth — here's what you can look forward to:
Own your stack. We give engineers real agency over technical decisions. You'll work in small, autonomous teams with direct access to production, where your choices have measurable impact and your input actively shapes how we build.
Stay sharp with dedicated learning opportunities. Beyond our campus library and free online courses, engineers get access to specialist technical meetups, internal guilds, architecture reviews, certifications, specialist tools, and hands-on experimentation time.
Ship fast, learn faster. We run a continuous deployment culture with short feedback loops. You'll move from idea to production in days — with the autonomy, tooling, and trust to iterate quickly and own your outcomes end to end.
AI-native engineering environment. We actively invest in AI tooling for developers — including coding assistants, AI-powered workflows, and dedicated experimentation time. We build it into how we work.
As you grow, so do we. This is why at trivago, we prioritize your development, offer personalized coaching through Nilo, and provide workshops, educational meetups, conferences, free online learning courses, and access to a fully-equipped campus library.
Enjoy your office days. Use your daily canteen budget to share lunch with colleagues in our canteen, help yourself to complimentary snacks and drinks in our kitchens, choose from a variety of fitness options with our on-site gym, sports classes, and Urban Sports Club membership, and enjoy the comfort of ergonomic desks and focused work areas.
Moving to join us? No problem. You can count on the visa support from our talent support team, a relocation package, interest-free newcomer loan, free language classes, regular team and many company-wide events to build experiences together.
Life happens. We offer self-determined vacation (with a minimum of 25 vacation days), flexible working hours, up to 2 work from home days weekly. Additionally you can work remotely from a different location, within Germany or selected countries abroad for up to 20 days per year. You also get free access to the Heycare platform for personalized nanny assistance, and an on-campus kids room.
Thank you for considering a career at trivago! Our commitment to fostering an inclusive and enriching environment for all talents is at the heart of what we do. ELECTRICAL ON-ORBIT HARDWARE RELIABILITY ENGINEER, SATELLITES (STARLINK)
SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide.

We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer products that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact.

As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team.
As a Satellite On-Orbit Hardware Reliability Engineer on Starlink, you will track, investigate, and analyze electrical and mechanical hardware failure modes on the largest space vehicle fleet in history.

Your daily work will include a combination of hardware testing, on-orbit data analysis, and collaboration with design, production, and operations engineers to act in response to on-orbit hardware anomalies.

You will use a mixture of electrical engineering analysis, statistical methods, and on-orbit experiments to achieve root cause for various failure mode investigations. You will provide critical insight at multiple points in the design and production process to ensure that hardware reliability increases over time.

Your experience will span the full scale of Starlink’s satellite engineering process: from the detailed physics of failure in a single hardware component, to its implications for the entire constellation, to the decisions made for future designs.

Analyze and track on-orbit hardware failures for the Starlink satellite constellation
Drive root cause investigation for major on-orbit hardware anomalies
Perform electrical bench testing and develop engineering models of failures to root cause and mitigate hardware anomalies
Work closely with engineers from adjacent disciplines (electrical, mechanical, thermal, software, test, operations, production) to eliminate sources of on-orbit failure
Drive continual improvements to our constellation by building and using tools to analyze data collected both on-orbit and in ground testing
Continuously improve the feedback loop from space using a mix of effective communication and automation

Strong understanding of failure mechanisms for electronic, mechanical, or optical systems
Experience leading failure investigations and root cause analysis
Experience performing environmental tests such as HALT/HASS campaigns, thermal cycling, vibration and shock testing, space environment effects testing

Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines
Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, enthusiasm for innovation, and commitment to improving reliability in cutting-edge technology

Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that is capable of delivering high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.

As we vertically integrate critical hardware, we are building and scaling  heterojunction (HJT) solar cell production  to power spacecraft and constellation assets with higher efficiency, lower mass, and proven reliability in the space environment.
We are looking for a  Solar Cell Reliability Engineer  who will  own the reliability lab and the end-to-end reliability story for our solar cells in space —from wafer and cell process through module integration, environmental qualification, on-orbit performance, and continuous improvement back into manufacturing.

Your work will ensure our solar cells deliver unmatched power density and durability for Starship, Starlink, AI Sat, and deep-space missions.

Your work will form the backbone of the Starlink network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world.

Own and operate the solar cell reliability lab: equipment strategy, capability roadmap, calibration, maintenance, safety, throughput, and data integrity for HJT cell and coupon reliability testing
Define, execute, and continuously improve the space reliability test matrix for HJT solar cells (e.g., thermal cycling, thermal vacuum, humidity/damp heat as applicable, UV/photo-stability, reverse bias / hotspot, mechanical shock/vibration at cell/coupon level, radiation exposure coordination, and accelerated life tests)
Build and own the reliability narrative for flight and program reviews: failure modes, physics of failure, acceleration models, life predictions, margins, and acceptance/qualification logic that ties lab data to on-orbit performance
Partner with HJT process and equipment engineering (texturing, PECVD/a-Si stacks, TCO, metallization, module integration) to link process parameters, metrology, and in-line defects to reliability outcomes; drive corrective actions and design-for-reliability changes
Establish reliability gates for process changes, tool qualifications, material substitutions, and supplier changes; own risk assessment (FMEA/PFMEA interfaces), sampling plans, and release criteria
Develop and maintain test methods, SOPs, fixturing, and automation for high-throughput, statistically defensible reliability characterization; ensure methods are transferable and auditable
Lead root cause analysis on reliability failures (electrical, optical, interfacial, mechanical, environmental) using SEM/FIB, EDS, FTIR, PL/EL, IV, quantum efficiency, adhesion, and other failure-analysis techniques; close the loop with manufacturing and design
Define and track reliability KPIs (e.g., degradation rates, wear-out distributions, infant mortality, lot-to-lot variation, correlation of accelerated tests to flight-like stress) and report status to leadership with clear recommendations
Interface with power systems, structures, thermal, radiation effects, quality, and flight reliability teams so cell-level reliability is coherent with array/module and spacecraft environments
Support flight anomaly investigation and on-orbit performance trending; update models and test strategies as flight data matures.
Mentor technicians and junior engineers; set lab culture for rigor, speed, and honest interpretation of data
Author and present technical content for design reviews, production readiness reviews, and customer/internal reliability packages as required

Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline
